title: Let constraints breed play
principle: Inventive interaction often comes from tight constraints—limited inputs, one sensor, one color—not from unlimited freedom.
procedure: Impose a tight constraint (one input, one material, 3 seconds, monochrome).
Brainstorm only inside the constraint for a fixed timebox.
Pick the idea that feels inevitable given the limit.
Expand only after the constrained idea is strong.
Document the constraint so the team doesn’t ‘help’ by removing it early.
examplePrompts:
Run a constrained ideation.

Hard constraint: <…>
Timebox: 25 minutes.
Produce 5 ideas that obey the constraint.
Select one that feels inevitable.
Forbid removing the constraint to ‘make it easier’.
promptWhy: Uses limits as a generative tool.
tips: Creative technology practice (Dawes and peers) often thrives on limits.
